summary: InvoiceResult and BillingItemResult search selections use the live-verified field sets (externalNumber, amountWithTax{format}, paymentProgress{status}, billingItemStatus, ...) instead of guessed scalars.
reason: Generated selections used guessed fields (number, status, total, scalar amount) that do not exist in Ignition's GraphQL schema; the corrected sets were copied from a live-verified internal GraphQL reference. Analytics must parse display-formatted money, prefer invoice paymentProgress.status over paymentStatus.displayName, use billingItemStatus for billing items, and display externalNumber when present. Preserve exact field sets on reprint.
validated_outcome: Live search-index invoices/billing-items return fully populated rows; amounts parse correctly in analytics rollups.
